subject.title: feat(browser): support GPT-5.6 Sol and update Oracle skill

question: After preserving custom API model IDs, should Oracle expose both the movable `gpt-5.6` family alias and the pinned `gpt-5.6-sol` alias?
rationale: The picker repair is established, but the generic alias creates a durable public model-name contract whose future target may change.

options.title: Expose both aliases
options.body: Keep `gpt-5.6` as the current family default and `gpt-5.6-sol` as the stable pinned target.

options.title: Expose Sol only
options.body: Add only `gpt-5.6-sol` until another GPT-5.6 picker target makes a movable family alias useful.

options.title: Land picker fix only
options.body: Merge unified-picker compatibility and defer the new GPT-5.6 alias surface.

recommendation.title: Expose both aliases
recommendation.body: Keep `gpt-5.6` as the current family default and `gpt-5.6-sol` as the stable pinned target.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current routing baseline and is the strongest history-backed owner for the public CLI model contract.
